class.name: SteamInventory
class.brief_description: Reads and changes the signed-in player's Steam inventory.
class.description: Get this service from [method SteamClient.inventory] after starting the Steam client. Enable Steam Inventory Service and publish the relevant item definitions for your AppID. Await the methods on the main thread. An inactive or unsupported scope returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE], invalid arguments return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER], and a full request queue returns [constant ERR_BUSY]. A pending request times out after 15 seconds. A submitted mutation may still apply after local observation ends. Stop or restart the owning client to retire its service and pending reads.

method.name: claim_playtime_drop
method.description: Evaluates the published playtime generator [param generator_id]. A successful evaluation can grant no items. Returns [SteamInventoryChangeResult]. Refresh inventory before retrying after a timeout.

method.name: claim_promotion
method.description: Asks Steam to apply the published promotion [param definition_id] if the signed-in player is eligible. Returns [SteamInventoryChangeResult]. Refresh inventory before retrying after a timeout.

method.name: claim_promotions
method.description: Asks Steam to apply all eligible configured promotions. A successful result can contain no grants. Returns [SteamInventoryChangeResult]. Refresh inventory before retrying after a timeout.

method.name: consume
method.description: Permanently consumes [param quantity] units from [param instance_id]. Use a confirmation step in the game UI before submitting this action. Returns [SteamInventoryChangeResult]. Refresh inventory before retrying after a timeout.

method.name: craft
method.description: Atomically exchanges the distinct owned [param ingredients] for one unit of [param output_definition_id] when a published Steam recipe matches. Steam validates the recipe and quantities before changing either side. Returns [SteamInventoryChangeResult]. Refresh inventory before retrying after a timeout.

method.name: definition
method.description: Loads the catalog as needed and returns [SteamItemDefinitionResult] for the published [param definition_id]. A valid ID absent from the catalog returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: definitions
method.description: Loads the app's published catalog on demand and returns [SteamItemDefinitionsResult]. Requests in the same scope share an in-flight load. A successful catalog may be empty.

method.name: items
method.description: Returns [SteamInventorySnapshotResult] for the signed-in player's full inventory. Call when a view needs refresh. Steam can rate-limit full reads and return cached results. Inspect the snapshot's freshness before making decisions that require current inventory.

method.name: items_by_id
method.description: Returns [SteamInventorySnapshotResult] for the available owned instances in [param instance_ids]. Steam may omit instances that are no longer present. Supply one to 256 distinct unsigned decimal IDs.

method.name: merge
method.description: Moves [param quantity] units from [param from_instance_id] into the distinct [param into_instance_id] stack. Steam enforces the matching definition and trade restrictions. Returns [SteamInventoryChangeResult]. Refresh inventory before retrying after a timeout.

method.name: proof
method.description: Returns [SteamBytesResult] with a signed Steam result containing exactly the available owned selection. Supply one to 256 distinct unsigned decimal [param instance_ids]. A missing selected instance returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST]. Proof bytes are limited to 1 MiB. Send them only to the authority that needs to verify this selection.

method.name: split
method.description: Moves [param quantity] units from [param instance_id] into a new instance of the same definition. The result carries the changed or removed source and the new stack. Returns [SteamInventoryChangeResult]. Refresh inventory before retrying after a timeout.

signal.name: definitions_changed
signal.description: Emitted after Steam announces a catalog update. An open catalog can call [method definitions] again to read the new revision.

signal.name: items_changed
signal.description: Emitted after this scope accepts a newer full inventory response to [method items]. The snapshot is detached and read-only. Mutations return their own changes.
